utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want to split the driving this week, or should I take the first shift?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can take the first shift this week.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — what day should I cover the second shift?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can help out with the carpool. What time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think around 8:00 would work, if that’s okay.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: 8:00 works for me — I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Pia—just checking, are we still on for the carpool this morning?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I’m still on for it—but I’d like to leave a few minutes early in case traffic is worse than usual.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, that works for me. I’ll be ready a few minutes early too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Opal — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — I need you at my place by 7:15 AM, if that works.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:15 AM works for me — I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m putting together the carpool and can loop you in right away if you want. If you’re in, I’ll send the details over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Please loop me in—I’d appreciate the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the carpool details right away so you’re in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. I’m thinking weekdays around 8:00 AM and 5:30 PM, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That should work for me — I can help with those weekday times. I’ll coordinate the details and let you know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the pickup time and address again so I can double-check the carpool details?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m usually a little late, but the pickup is at 7:15 at 24 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got 7:15 at 24 Maple Street. I’ll double-check that and plan for a little extra time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the 8:15 drop-off on Monday and Wednesday, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, thanks Faye — I’ll cover the other mornings.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, that works for me. I’ll let you know if anything changes on my end.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hey Jules — I heard the carpool might be changing, but I’m not sure what the latest is. What’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Nell — I’m still waiting on the final word, but it sounds like we may need to shuffle a couple pick-up spots. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — just let me know when it’s confirmed, and I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — what time are we carpooling?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we leaving at 7:30?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks Rey — I was thinking around 7:30 if that works for you?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me. Just let me know where you want to meet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let the others know the carpool plan and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and make sure we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the carpool plan so everyone knows what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Rey — any update on the carpool? I can adjust my errands around it if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard anything new yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. I’ll keep my phone handy and plan around whatever you hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool—sorry, I was a bit scattered there. What time did we agree to meet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We said 8:15 by the corner, right? I’ll repeat it to the others too so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, 8:15 by the corner — thanks for the reminder. I’ll be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the carpool — what changed again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We just moved the pickup to 8:15 and I’m covering Tuesdays now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, got it — 8:15 and you’ve got Tuesdays now. Thanks for the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand with the carpool if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll send you the pickup times, and we’ll stick to the same route each day.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — send the pickup times my way, and I’ll keep to the same route each day.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I can help with the carpool. What times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh great, thanks Mara! I was thinking maybe around 8:00 AM on weekdays, and I’ll send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — 8:00 AM on weekdays works for me. Just send the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help keep the carpool organized. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’m thinking 7:30 AM works best for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 7:30 AM works for me too — I’ll make sure everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help keep the carpool organized. What days and pickup times are we working with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa. I’m still gathering everyone’s schedules, but I’ll send you the days and pickup times as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — just send them over when you have them, and I’ll line everything up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits and pieces about the carpool—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m trying to pin down the schedule and who’s driving this week. Do you want the latest update or just the pickup times?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Just the pickup times would help me most—I’m still catching up on the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time should I be ready for carpool?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Please be ready by 7:30 — I’ll swing by right after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll be ready by 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What time are we thinking?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do you mean the morning school run, or the afternoon pickup?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I mean the morning school run — I can do that one.
